title: Rethinking AI companions for young people
discussion_signal: The post acknowledges the appeal of AI companions that listen without judgment but argues that resilience, empathy, and trust are learned through human relationships in ways AI cannot fully replicate. It adds a cultural and developmental counter-signal to convenience and substitution narratives.
linked_research_question: When AI companions feel emotionally available, what happens to face-to-face trust, developmental learning, and the meaning of relationship?
limits: No youth sample or measured behavioral outcome is presented
The claim about what AI cannot replicate is normative rather than experimentally established
